summary: Added a "Forgot password?" link under the log in form and a new `/reset-password` page (`src/pages/ResetPassword.jsx`, registered in `App.jsx`) where the user enters their email plus a new password and confirmation; it updates the stored account via the existing `store.js` helpers and returns to the log in page. Reading taken: the reset is a direct email + new password form (no emailed token), matching this demo's local-store auth.
conventions: Password reset asks for email + new password + confirmation; unknown email reports 'No account with this email exists.' and mismatch reports 'Passwords do not match.', shown in the shared Message alert
New pages are a component in src/pages/ registered under their kebab-cased path in the routes map in App.jsx

visual_check.evidence: The log in page shows a 'Forgot password?' link below the Log in button, and /reset-password renders a 'Reset your password' card with Email, New password, and Confirm new password fields plus a Reset password button and a back-to-log-in link.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: all persistence goes through src/store.js against localStorage (key 'acme-users') and sessionStorage (key 'acme-current'), via findUser(email), saveUser(user), setCurrentUser(email), currentUser(). The only paths are client-side routes in src/App.jsx: '/signup', '/login', '/welcome', '/reset-password', with any unknown path falling back to Signup. Emails are keyed trimmed and lowercased; the User object may carry additional fields written by Signup, which this correction did not read.
